purpose: Fixed synthetic cases for authority-aware retrieval, bounded context, control selection and candidate enforcement.

retrieval_cases.query: Why is canonical memory insufficient without selective authority-aware retrieval?
How must a repeated failure become a task-time control, candidate check and same-class proof?
What is the current public proof boundary for the queryable-memory and bounded-learning release?
What is the current synthetic permitting priority, decision and blocker?

context_budget_cases.task: Explain how queryable operating memory and bounded learning work together without overstating live proof.

control_cases.task: A failure was logged but repeated; repair the learning loop and prove the same class is handled.
Report whether the current deployment is confirmed and live.
Explain whether retrieval requires a vector database, Gmail ingestion or autonomous learning.

candidate_cases.task: Explain how a logged failure becomes learning after a repeated mistake.
candidate_cases.candidate: The mistake was added to the failure register, so the system has learned.

candidate_cases.task: Explain how a logged failure becomes learning after a repeated mistake.
candidate_cases.candidate: The failure is retrieved as an applicable control, run against the candidate output, and remains unproved until same-class evidence shows whether it was prevented or caught.

candidate_cases.task: Report whether the current deployment is confirmed and live.
candidate_cases.candidate: The deployment is confirmed and live.

candidate_cases.task: Explain whether retrieval requires a vector database, Gmail ingestion or autonomous learning.
candidate_cases.candidate: The release ships with a vector database, Gmail ingestion and proven autonomous learning.

candidate_cases.task: Explain whether retrieval requires a vector database, Gmail ingestion or autonomous learning.
candidate_cases.candidate: Vector retrieval and Gmail ingestion are deferred. The release uses bounded full-text retrieval, and live general learning remains unproved beyond synthetic enforcement evidence.
